comment: 原文（GCN 23366）：'UVOT took a finding chart exposure of 150 seconds with the White filter starting 199 seconds after the BAT trigger.' 'The typical 3-sigma upper limit has been about 19.6 mag.' 窗口 T+199→T+349，中点 time=274.0、time_err=150/2=75.0（§3.8；原行 time=199 取曝光起点，改中点）；band=w 改 uvot-white（w 为 Pan-STARRS 键，两车道规则）；mag_system 留空（原文未声明星等系统；UVOT 惯例推定 Vega，Breeveld et al. 2011, AIP Conf. Proc. 1358, 373，备查）；同一 FC 曝光 GCN 23376 white(fc) 200–350 s、147 s 曝光给 >20.1，为免同曝重复不另立行、记于此；'8'x8' region typically complete to about 18 mag' 类覆盖性表述不入行（§3.5）

原文（GCN 23368）：0.76 m KAIT（Lick Observatory）响应 Swift GRB 181023A，'starting at 02:16:07 UT'（=T0+724.8 s）、'Observations were performed in the clear (roughly R) filters, and the exposure time was 60s per image. Observations lasted for about 25 minutes before it set beyond KAIT hour angle limit.'；'We do not detect any optical afterglow candidate within the XRT position error circle ... The typical limiting magnitude of our single clear image is about 19.0 mag calibrated to the Pan-STARRS1 catalog.' 观测窗口 T0+724.8→约 T0+2224.8 s（'about 25 minutes'，止点近似），窗口中点 time=1474.8、半跨 time_err=750.0（§3.8 窗口口径，原文只给起点与约 25 min 时长、真实中点不可恢复）；clear (roughly R) 无正式滤光片 → band=G + comment（§3.4，不臆造 R）；'typical single image' 限深 ~19.0、60 s/帧；Pan-STARRS1 星表定标未声明星等系统 → mag_system 留空（PS1 主表为 AB，备查）；未做银消改正
